description: Public sample road-traffic clip, location not in the pilot area; used only to demonstrate the counting method. Fixed elevated camera looking down a two-carriageway road; all visible traffic travels toward the camera. Counting line: horizontal at 58% of frame height (y = 418 of 720), from the left edge to 58% of the width, spanning both carriageways and the left footpath.

line.note: Directed left to right; moving downward in the image (toward the camera) = inbound, upward (away) = outbound. 'inbound' here only means toward the camera, not toward any stand or city.

clip_label: Public sample road-traffic clip (original title: 4K Road traffic video for object detection and tracking). Actual resolution 1280x720 at 30 fps.
